description.help: What this catalog row does: its rule, behaviour and any legal or operational note.

child_leave_allocations.help: Manual per-child leave-day allocations keyed by catalogue code, then the child’s birth date: { SHARED_PARENTAL_LEAVE: { "2026-04-01": 45 } }. Empty uses the jurisdiction default.

children.help: Children under one year, with the expected or actual birth date.

dependents_count.help: The number of dependants the person supports. Each statutory scheme decides how many count.

effective_range.help: The dates this agreement applies. A replacement contract continues employment; ending it records a reason.

employee_extension_data.help: The employee data the jurisdiction's employee extension schema declares.

engagement.help: The contracted role. PAYEE is paid without employment (a commission agent), outside the headcount and separations.

events.help: Dated statutory events on this contract: illness, bereavement, marriage, work injury, confinement and similar. Child birth is the structured `children` list; termination is the contract status and reason.

exit_ground.help: The statutory ground for ending the employment. It decides severance eligibility and exit duties; reason carries the narrative.

final_pay_due_on.help: The actual contractual date the final settlement becomes payable. This differs from the maximum statutory deadline and the run’s actual payment date.

only_child.help: The employee is an only child.

reason.help: Why this record was voided or the employment ended.

service_started_on.help: The date service began for leave and benefit entitlements. A same-jurisdiction replacement keeps the predecessor date; a cross-jurisdiction replacement starts new statutory service.

allowances.help: The agreed allowances, keyed by the catalog code; the catalog row carries how each behaves.

annual_leave_carry_limit_days.help: An agreed contractual limit for carrying annual leave into the next leave year.

employer_bears_income_tax.help: The agreement makes the employer bear the employee’s income tax. The jurisdiction formula determines any required gross-up.

normal_days_per_week.help: The ordinary working days of one week.

normal_hours_per_day.help: The ordinary hours of one working day. Every overtime, leave and statutory hour reads it.

normal_hours_per_week.help: The ordinary hours of one working week.

probation_period.help: The original agreed probation dates. Salary amendments retain these dates; they do not start another probation.

signed_on.help: The actual date this employment agreement was signed.

work_region.help: The worksite region key the jurisdiction minimum-wage tables use, where it differs from the employer region.

worksite.help: The establishment or site the person works at, where the law applies thresholds by site.

work_pass_valid_until.help: The actual expiry date of the current work pass. Renewal changes it while the contract is sealed; the reminder key follows the date.

employee_contract.recordLabel: [record.employee_name != null ? string(record.employee_name) : '', record.employee_number != null ? string(record.employee_number) : ''].filter(part, part != '').join(' · ')

first_hired_on.help: The first day this person joined the employer group. Company service stays with the person across entity and jurisdiction transfers.

code.help: The company’s stable business code for imports and cross-references. This is separate from its immutable record ID, name, jurisdiction and dated registration numbers.

epf_registered_on.help: The actual date the employer registered with the Employees Provident Fund. A missing date means not yet recorded, not unregistered.

pay_days.help: The day each cycle part pays, in order; the last entry repeats. A day past the month end pays on the last day.
The day each cycle part pays, in order; the last entry repeats. A day past the month end pays on the last day.
The day each cycle part pays, in order; the last entry repeats. A day past the month end pays on the last day.
The day each cycle part pays, in order; the last entry repeats. A day past the month end pays on the last day.

socso_registered_on.help: The actual date the employer registered with PERKESO; the single registration covers SOCSO and EIS. A missing date means not yet recorded, not unregistered.

effective_from.help: The first day of a future month. The open employer version ends the day before it.

field_path.help: One of name, representative_name, registered_address, time_zone, final_pay_loan_floor_percent, overtime_full_award_percent, bank or entity_extension_data. A dotted path changes one nested value.

new_value.help: The value that stands from the effective date, as JSON: a quoted string, a number, true/false, or an object.

entity_extension_data.help: The entity data the jurisdiction's entity extension schema declares.

final_pay_loan_floor_percent.help: The share of expected final pay that must remain after loan recovery.

overtime_full_award_percent.help: How much of planned overtime the clock must cover to pay all of it. Below this, the clocked time pays, rounded down to the half hour.

representative_name.help: The responsible person the law names for filing and registration duties.

time_zone.help: The zone this entity's payroll windows and rostered days are counted in.

days.help: The divisor when the basis is FIXED (Malaysia 26, China 21.75, Thailand and Taiwan 30).

hours.help: The divisor when the basis is FIXED (Indonesia 173, China 174).

work_regions.help: The work-region keys this jurisdiction recognises, mapped to their display names. A contract picks one key.

account.help: Catalogue family key, for example leave or claim.

code.help: Account code inside the family, for example ANNUAL_LEAVE.

measure.help: What is held in that window.

period.help: The window the value belongs to, for example MY.S.2026-03-05.

source.help: What caused this movement. Plain text, so a movement outlives what caused it.

description.help: What this catalog row does: its rule, behaviour and any legal or operational note.

consent.help: The signed per-day consent for night work and overtime while raising a child under 12 months. Pregnancy never takes consent.

cycle.help: A repeating rotation longer than a week. Its first day is the pattern effective start; use days for a weekly pattern.

week_start.help: The weekday the statutory week opens on. The contract period owns the dates.

description.help: What this catalog row does: its rule, behaviour and any legal or operational note.

severity.help: The injury or loss classification. Non-injury cases such as harassment or data mishandling use N/A.
